title: Boss: The Checklist
concept: Before every move: checks, captures, threats, for you AND your opponent.

glossary.definition: 15 puzzles from every lesson, on the clock, with no hints. Three of them ask you to defend. You need ★★ to beat it.

summary: The checklist, every single move: what is my opponent threatening? What checks, captures and threats do I have? Answer those, and you'll play like Bapu.

narration: The boss level. No hints, a clock, and puzzles from every lesson. Before each move, run the checklist: checks, captures, threats, for you AND your opponent.
Black's queen gives check. Checklist step one: what is my opponent threatening? My king, right now.
Rook to f3 blocks the check. But look up the f-file: the rook also attacks the queen, and Black's own king stands right behind her. She's pinned!
The queen can only take the rook, with check.
Your king takes the queen. One move that defends AND attacks: that's what the checklist finds.
